title: The Name Is the Contract:\\ A Promotion Gate Called mcnemar\_exact Is Not Exact ---\\ and, Against the Two-Sided Exact Reference,\\ Every Flip Favors Promotion

stages.details: The local source hash is checked; publication identity is separate.
Claims must be registered and bound to evidence fields.
Native gates passed: 1; bound to the current source: 1. A completed experiment is not a reproduced experiment.
A bibliography file is only a candidate until citations resolve.
Open Critical or Major findings block the package.
Mechanical packageability is separate from scientific readiness.
Upload, account use and publication require explicit user authorization.

next_actions.done_when: Each claim is verified, explicitly hedged with missing evidence, or removed.
No open Critical or Major finding remains against the current hashes.

next_actions.reason: Blocked claims cannot enter strong prose: C11.
next_actions.done_when: Blocked claims are absent from manuscript assertions or repaired.
Each failed gate is repaired or explicitly blocked in the manuscript scope.

next_actions.reason: The package manifest contains unresolved blockers.
next_actions.done_when: The source tree, bibliography, compiled PDF and hashes are complete.

next_actions.reason: Q-One cannot perform an account-level arXiv action on its own.
next_actions.done_when: The user explicitly authorizes upload and checks metadata, license and author list.

notes: A mechanical package check is not scientific readiness.
